title: Finite nondeterministic oracle machine
statement: Define a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with no ordinary work tapes and four states numbered $0,1,2,3$. Its underlying machine is the table specified by the initial state $0$, query state $1$, positive-answer state $2$, and negative-answer state $3$; these three special states are pairwise distinct.
